sloka: तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा सुरभिः सा असृजत् तदा ।तस्या हुंभा रव उत्सृष्टाः पह्लवाः शतशो नृप ॥१-५४-१८॥
transliteration: tasya tat vacanam śrutvā surabhiḥ sā asṛjat tadā ।tasyā huṁbhā rava utsṛṣṭāḥ pahlavāḥ śataśo nṛpa ॥1-54-18॥

translations.english: Hearing his words Kamadhenu created an army. O Rama her lowing brought into being Paplavas in hundreds who destroyed the entire army of Viswamitra, while he looked on helplessly.
translations.hindi: प्रजापति के पुत्र कुश नाम के एक राजा हो गये हे । उनके पुत्र कुशनाभ बड़े बलवान्‌ और धर्मात्मा राजा हुए
